mutants.description: Removes the populated table's last-updated line: the Stale row of the eight-state table (UX design 1.6 States 'last-updated time'; v5 1.2 Stale; capability AC-24; review v1 IR-001)

Shows the time of rendering instead of the time the list was read (fetchedAt): any re-render moves the time without a re-read (UX design 1.6 States last-updated time; review v1 IR-001 'render the table read's last-updated time ... from fetchedAt')
Renders the raw ISO-8601 UTC string instead of UX design 0.7's timestamp form (America/Chicago with the zone shown; review v1 IR-001 'Use UX design 0.7's timestamp form')
Drops the time of day from the last-updated time, leaving only the date (UX design 0.7 timestamp form YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM zone; UX design 1.6 States last-updated time)

Changes the last-updated line's words away from 'Last updated' (UX design 1.6 States / v5 1.2 Stale 'Last-updated time'; the sibling taken-over screens' 'Last updated {time}' that review v1 IR-001 points to)
Sets the last-updated timestamp at --text-sm instead of --text-xs (UX design 0.7 '--text-xs timestamps'; ui-components design tokens; AC-26)
Drops --font-numeric from the last-updated time (ui-components design tokens '--font-numeric for every count and time'; AC-26)

A stop that succeeds after an earlier refusal leaves that refusal in state, so the next stock's dialog shows a refusal that is not its own (review v1 IR-002 'a dialog opened for a stock never shows a refusal from an earlier one'; STD-UI-19 three-part errors; AC-25)

Moves the pending hold after the await, so the confirmation is not held while the stop is in flight and a second activation sends a second DELETE (review v1 IR-002 'one stop per confirmation'; AC-17, AC-25)

Releases the hold only on success: after a refused stop the dialog stays held, so Cancel/Escape cannot close it and Stop following cannot be retried (CAP-001 IR-004 refusal kept in an open, usable dialog; AC-17; ConfirmDialog pending contract)

Releases the hold only on failure: after a successful stop pending stays true, so the next stock's dialog opens with Stop following held and Cancel blocked (AC-17 every stop remains available; review v1 IR-002)

Moves closing the dialog from the success path into finally, so a refused stop closes the dialog instead of keeping it open with its refusal (CAP-001 IR-004 kept by AC-17; task plan T007 (j); review v1 IR-002 context)
Stops passing the in-flight flag to RetireDialog, so the confirmation is never held and a double activation sends two DELETEs (review v1 IR-002; AC-17, AC-25)
Inverts the hold: every dialog opens with Stop following held and Cancel blocked, and is released only while a stop is in flight (AC-17, AC-25; review v1 IR-002)
Cancelling after a refused stop keeps the refusal, so the next dialog opened (for the same or another stock) shows a refusal of an earlier stop (review v1 IR-002 remediation; STD-UI-19; AC-25)

RetireDialog drops its pending prop instead of passing it to ConfirmDialog: the confirm action is not aria-disabled and Escape/Cancel still close while the stop is in flight (review v1 IR-002 'Passing pending is the dialog's own mechanism'; AC-17, AC-25)
The screen h1 leaves the type scale's --text-xl (UX design 0.7 '--text-xl screen h1s'; task plan T019 (1); AC-26; review v1 IR-003 / reviewer mutant r1)
Drops --muted-foreground from the last-updated line
A successful stop leaves the dialog open (AC-17: the confirmed stop completes and the dialog closes)
Renders the last-updated time in the viewer's locale and machine zone (STD-UI-5)
Inverts the hold inside RetireDialog: every idle dialog is held and Escape/Cancel cannot close it
Moves the last-updated time on when a further keyset page is appended (no artifact fixes which read the time names)
Swaps the order of clearing the refusal and holding the dialog (same render batch)
The h1 reverts to the delivered *Instruments*; UX design 1.6 / DAC-E7-4 / DAC-E7-S3-4 fix it as *Followed stocks* (task plan T005 kills note).

mutants.new:
const focusAddRequested =
    (location.state as { focusAdd?: boolean } | null)?.focusAdd === true;
mutants.description: The hint is read from the live location on every render instead of captured once on mount, so consuming it (state: null) withdraws the focus before the add field mounts; DAC-E7-6 / DAC-E7-S3-1 and task plan T019(2) (useState initialiser) require the field focused once when opened with focusAdd.

The guard on consuming the hint is lost: every open, hint or not, replaces its history entry (dropping the hash and any other router state); task plan T019(2) calls navigate only when focusAddRequested.
Consuming the hint drops the URL's query string; task plan T019(2) / Resolved Conflict 3 replace the entry with the same pathname and search, changing only the state.
The replaced history entry keeps the focusAdd hint, so a reload of that entry re-focuses the add field; DAC-E7-6 'a reload MUST NOT re-focus', task plan T019(2) state: null.

The never-populated autofocus is lost (clause dropped): with nothing followed the add field no longer takes focus; UX design 1.6 States, task plan T011 and Other Notes 'Focus and the never-populated state'.
Following a stock through the add field no longer re-reads the screen and table, so the new stock does not appear; AC-17 (same outcome as delivered), task plan T019 'reload-token pattern'.
Following many no longer re-reads the screen and table, so the followed stocks do not appear; AC-5 / AC-17, task plan T019 'reload-token pattern'.

The table no longer receives the reload token, so after a follow the screen re-reads but the table keeps its stale rows and counts; AC-17, task plan T019(3) populated renderer <InstrumentTable refreshToken={reloadToken} />.
The never-populated state renders the no-match copy; UX design 1.6 / DAC-E7-4 'No stocks followed yet.', distinct from no-match (task plan T011 kills note, TC-COMP-133).
The add region renders while the first read is pending (clause dropped); task plan T019(4) renders it for every kind except loading and unreachable, as delivered.
Try again on the screen's read error does nothing; task plan T019(3) / T011 onRetry bumps reloadToken and re-reads listInstruments once (AC-24, UX design 1.6 States).
The first-page request drops the lifecycle filter, so choosing Stopped following sends no lifecycle; AC-17 / DAC-E7-S3-6 same query parameters (task plan T007 kills note, case d).

The next keyset page is requested without the lifecycle filter, so paging a filtered list appends unfiltered stocks; task plan T018 'handleLoadMore keeps the delivered cursor request', DAC-E7-11, AC-17.

mutants.description: The next keyset page is requested without the symbol filter, so paging a filtered list appends non-matching stocks; task plan T018 same cursor request, DAC-E7-11, AC-17.
The next page is prepended instead of appended, so the keyset order breaks; task plan T018 'appends with [...current, ...page.rows]', CAP-003-E1-S4 Other Notes.
A failed next-page read is swallowed: no error state renders and the list looks complete; AC-17 (the delivered paging reported its failure), AC-24 error through StateRegion.
The table asks for more when there is none and never when there is, so the second keyset page is never requested; DAC-E7-11 / task plan T007 kills note (case e).
The table is not marked busy while the next page loads (no aria-busy, onEndReached not held back); task plan T018 busy={loadingMore}, CAP-003-E1-S4 DEC-0306/DEC-0307.
The symbol cell is no longer the row header, so rows lose their accessible row name; task plan T018 prescribes `DataTable variant="virtualised" rowHeader`.
Try again on the table's read error does nothing; task plan T007(m) / T018(1) onRetry bumps reloadToken and re-reads once (task plan T007 kills note).
Reset filter clears only the symbol filter, leaving the lifecycle filter applied; task plan T007(l) / T018(1) 'Reset filter clearing both filters'.
Reset filter renders as the primary button instead of `Button variant="outline"` (task plan T018(1)), AC-26.
The row action Stop following renders as an outline button instead of `Button variant="ghost"` (task plan T018(3)), AC-26.
The count names the followed and stopped-following totals the wrong way round; UX design 1.6 / DAC-E7-4 '{n} followed, {m} stopped following' (task plan T018(2)).
The count reverts to the delivered *retired*; DAC-E7-4 / DAC-E7-S3-4 (task plan T005 kills note).

With no lifecycle filter (initially and after Reset filter) the Select shows no current value instead of *All*; task plan T018(2) maps 'all' to the delivered empty filter both ways (Other Notes, Radix Select and the empty filter).

The confirm button reverts to the delivered *Stop acquiring*; DAC-E7-9 **Stop following** (task plan T003 kills note).
Escape and Cancel no longer call onCancel, so the dialog cannot be dismissed and focus never returns; AC-25, DAC-E7-9 (task plan T003 kills note).
The dialog shows a 'Stopping following {SYMBOL} failed' alert with no failure; task plan T003 'with no error, no alert', IR-004.
The recognition marker renders the failed outcome (Failed, status-critical) instead of Not found / status-warning; AC-14, DAC-E7-S3-5, ux-brief 12.2 (task plan T006 kills note).
A followed stock gets a good-tier badge instead of its word alone; DEC-0389 (no badge, no tier), task plan T013.
The duplicate and malformed field errors swap; task plan T008 kills note ('{SYM} is already a followed stock.' vs '{input} does not match the required symbol shape.').
The add field focuses on mount when not asked to and not when asked; DAC-E7-S3-1, UX design 1.6 States (task plan T008 kills note).
Follow a stock stays enabled while the request is in flight; task plan T015 keeps the delivered native disabled={submitting} (IR-003).
Clicking Follow a stock no longer submits the form (only Enter does); AC-17 same outcome, task plan T015 `Button ... with type="submit"`.
Follow many is blocked when symbols are recognised and usable when none are; IR-003 / TC-COMP-130 (task plan T009 kills note).
Rejected entries are counted as recognised and sent; AC-5 (task plan T009 kills note).
The Follow many submit stays enabled while its request is in flight; task plan T016 disabled={!blocked && submitting} (IR-003).
The result line reports the rejected count as followed; task plan T016 '{a} followed, {r} followed again, {j} rejected' (IR-008).
Download now is blocked when history depth is set and usable when it is not; DAC-E2-S4-3, AC-17 (task plan T010 kills note).
The screen h1 drops from --text-xl; UX design 0.7 (--text-xl screen h1s), task plan T019(1) h1 *Followed stocks* (`text-xl`).
The screen's loading copy reverts to the delivered *Loading…*; task plan T019(3) *Loading followed stocks…*.
The screen's read error drops its reason; UX design 0.7 three-part errors, task plan T019(3).
The add region is hidden while the list errors; UX design 1.6 States: the error preserves the add field's value; task plan T019(4).
The table's loading copy reverts to the delivered domain word; AC-19, task plan T018(1).
Every symbol link is muted, followed ones too; UX design 1.6 Token Usage (stopped-following rows --muted-foreground), task plan T018(3).
No row ever carries Not found, even when the caller names it; AC-14, task plan T018(3), Open Gap 1.
The table's region loses its name; task plan T018(3).
The row action's visible text loses its object; UX design 1.6 Labels (**Stop following**), task plan T018(3).
The count keeps the delivered *active*; UX design 1.6 Labels (*active* -> *followed*), DAC-E7-4.

The columns ignore a later notFoundSymbols, so a symbol named after mount never shows Not found; task plan T018(3) renders RecognitionBadge when notFoundSymbols.has(row.symbol), Open Gap 1 (the seam a data source will use).
The symbol column header carries a banned domain word; AC-19, DAC-E7-S3-4 (probes the vocabulary scan).
The lifecycle filter loses its accessible name; task plan T018(2).
